an1.31:1.1: “Mendicants, I do not see a single thing that is so very harmful as this mind that is not tamed.
an1.31:1.2: An untamed mind is very harmful.”
an1.32:1.1: “Mendicants, I do not see a single thing that is so very beneficial as this mind that is tamed.
an1.32:1.2: A tamed mind is very beneficial.”
an1.33:1.1: “Mendicants, I do not see a single thing that is so very harmful as this mind that is not guarded.
an1.33:1.2: An unguarded mind is very harmful.”
an1.34:1.1: “Mendicants, I do not see a single thing that is so very beneficial as this mind that is guarded.
an1.34:1.2: A guarded mind is very beneficial.”
an1.35:1.1: “Mendicants, I do not see a single thing that is so very harmful as this mind that is not protected.
an1.35:1.2: An unprotected mind is very harmful.”
an1.36:1.1: “Mendicants, I do not see a single thing that is so very beneficial as this mind that is protected.
an1.36:1.2: A protected mind is very beneficial.”
an1.37:1.1: “Mendicants, I do not see a single thing that is so very harmful as this mind that is not restrained.
an1.37:1.2: An unrestrained mind is very harmful.”
an1.38:1.1: “Mendicants, I do not see a single thing that is so very beneficial as this mind that is restrained.
an1.38:1.2: A restrained mind is very beneficial.”
an1.39:1.1: “Mendicants, I do not see a single thing that is so very harmful as this mind that is not tamed, guarded, protected, and restrained.
an1.39:1.2: An untamed, unguarded, unprotected, and unrestrained mind is very harmful.”
an1.40:1.1: “Mendicants, I do not see a single thing that is so very beneficial as this mind that is tamed, guarded, protected, and restrained.
an1.40:1.2: A tamed, guarded, protected, and restrained mind is very beneficial.”
